sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers_on_promo_rate`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`promotional_rate_flag` = TRUE

SELECT
  `subscription_plan`.`service_tier` AS `service_tier`,
  ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(`subscription`.`termination_date`, CAST(`churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` AS DATE)), `subscription`.`activation_date`)), 1) AS `average_days_on_last_plan_before_cancellation`,
  COUNT(*) AS `cancellations`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  ON `churn_event`.`subscription_id` = `subscription`.`subscription_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`service_tier` IS NOT NULL
  AND `subscription`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(`subscription`.`termination_date`, CAST(`churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` AS DATE)) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `subscription_plan`.`service_tier`
ORDER BY `average_days_on_last_plan_before_cancellation` DESC

WITH `churned_accounts` AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT `subscriber_id`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event`
  WHERE `subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL
),
`accounts_with_failed_payments` AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT `invoice`.`subscriber_id`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`payment` AS `payment`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice` AS `invoice`
    ON `payment`.`invoice_id` = `invoice`.`invoice_id`
  WHERE `payment`.`payment_status` = 'Failed'
    AND `invoice`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS `total_cancellations`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `f`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `cancellations_with_failed_payment_history`,
  try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `f`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0,COUNT(*)) AS `share_with_failed_payment_history`
FROM `churned_accounts` AS `c`
LEFT JOIN `accounts_with_failed_payments` AS `f`
  ON `c`.`subscriber_id` = `f`.`subscriber_id`

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `annual_paying_subs_up_for_renewal_next_60_days`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`subscription_type` = 'Annual'
  AND `subscription`.`current_term_end_date` IS NOT NULL
  AND `subscription`.`current_term_end_date` > DATE'2026-11-11'
  AND `subscription`.`current_term_end_date` <= date_add(DATE'2026-11-11', 60)

SELECT CASE WHEN `video_resolution` = '4K' THEN '4K' ELSE 'Rest' END AS `resolution_group`, try_divide(SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`, try_divide(100.0 * SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`),SUM(SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`)) OVER ()) AS `viewing_percent` FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` WHERE `video_resolution` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN `video_resolution` = '4K' THEN '4K' ELSE 'Rest' END ORDER BY `viewing_percent` DESC

SELECT 'Film' AS `category`, try_divide(AVG(`runtime_seconds`),60.0) AS `avg_runtime_minutes`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title`
WHERE `content_type` = 'Film'
  AND `runtime_seconds` IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Regular series episode' AS `category`, try_divide(AVG(`runtime_seconds`),60.0) AS `avg_runtime_minutes`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode`
WHERE `episode_type` = 'Episode'
  AND `runtime_seconds` IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN `series`.`series_status` = 'Ongoing' THEN 'Ongoing'
    WHEN `series`.`series_status` = 'Completed' THEN 'Finished'
    ELSE `series`.`series_status`
  END AS `show_status`,
  COUNT(*) AS `series_count`,
  AVG(`series`.`total_season_count`) AS `avg_seasons`,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY `series`.`total_season_count`) AS `median_seasons`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` AS `series`
WHERE `series`.`series_status` IS NOT NULL
  AND `series`.`total_season_count` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN `series`.`series_status` = 'Ongoing' THEN 'Ongoing'
    WHEN `series`.`series_status` = 'Completed' THEN 'Finished'
    ELSE `series`.`series_status`
  END
ORDER BY `show_status`

WITH `subtitle_counts` AS (
  SELECT
    `playback_session`.`subtitle_language`,
    COUNT(`playback_session`.`playback_session_id`) AS `sessions`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  WHERE `playback_session`.`subtitle_language` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `playback_session`.`subtitle_language`
), `ranked_subtitles` AS (
  SELECT
    `subtitle_counts`.`subtitle_language`,
    `subtitle_counts`.`sessions`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `subtitle_counts`.`sessions` DESC) AS `subtitle_rank`
  FROM `subtitle_counts`
)
SELECT
  `ranked_subtitles`.`subtitle_language`,
  `ranked_subtitles`.`sessions`
FROM `ranked_subtitles`
WHERE `ranked_subtitles`.`subtitle_rank` = 1

SELECT `campaign_type` AS objective,
  COUNT(DISTINCT `campaign_id`) AS live_status_campaigns,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `start_date` <= DATE'2026-11-10' AND (`end_date` IS NULL OR `end_date` >= DATE'2026-11-10') THEN `campaign_id` END) AS in_flight_on_2026_11_10,
  MIN(`start_date`) AS earliest_start, MAX(`end_date`) AS latest_end
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`campaign`
WHERE `campaign_status` = 'Live'
GROUP BY `campaign_type`
ORDER BY live_status_campaigns DESC
SELECT `campaign_status`, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(`end_date`) AS latest_end FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`campaign` GROUP BY 1

SELECT `campaign_type` AS objective, COUNT(DISTINCT `campaign_id`) AS live_status_campaigns, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `start_date` <= DATE'2026-11-10' AND (`end_date` IS NULL OR `end_date` >= DATE'2026-11-10') THEN `campaign_id` END) AS in_flight_on_2026_11_10, MIN(`start_date`) AS earliest_start, MAX(`end_date`) AS latest_end FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`campaign` WHERE `campaign_status` = 'Live' GROUP BY `campaign_type` ORDER BY live_status_campaigns DESC
SELECT `campaign_status`, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(`end_date`) AS latest_end FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`campaign` GROUP BY 1

SELECT `order_type`, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(`total_contracted_value`) AS gross_contracted_value_usd, ROUND(100*SUM(`total_contracted_value`)/SUM(SUM(`total_contracted_value`)) OVER (),1) AS pct_of_gross, SUM(`net_order_value`) AS net_order_value_usd FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`ad_order` GROUP BY `order_type` ORDER BY gross_contracted_value_usd DESC

SELECT `currency_code`, `order_status`, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(`total_contracted_value`) AS gross, MAX(`total_contracted_value`) AS max_line FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`ad_order` GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT COALESCE(p.`strategic_tier`,'(none)') AS strategic_tier, d.`currency_code`,
 COUNT(DISTINCT p.`partner_id`) AS partners, COUNT(DISTINCT d.`acquisition_deal_id`) AS deals,
 SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`) AS total_deal_value,
 SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_status`='Active' THEN d.`deal_value_amount` END) AS active_deal_value,
 ROUND(100*SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`)/SUM(SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`)) OVER (),1) AS pct_of_value
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_partner`.`acquisition_deal` d
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_partner`.`partner` p ON d.`partner_id`=p.`partner_id`
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY total_deal_value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(p.`strategic_tier`,'(none)') AS strategic_tier, d.`currency_code`, COUNT(DISTINCT p.`partner_id`) AS partners, COUNT(DISTINCT d.`acquisition_deal_id`) AS deals, SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`) AS total_deal_value, SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_status`='Active' THEN d.`deal_value_amount` END) AS active_deal_value, ROUND(100*SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`)/SUM(SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`)) OVER (),1) AS pct_of_value FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_partner`.`acquisition_deal` d LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_partner`.`partner` p ON d.`partner_id`=p.`partner_id` GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY total_deal_value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(p.`strategic_tier`,'(none)') AS strategic_tier, d.`currency_code`,
 COUNT(DISTINCT p.`partner_id`) AS partners, COUNT(DISTINCT d.`acquisition_deal_id`) AS deals,
 SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`) AS total_deal_value,
 SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_status`='Active' THEN d.`deal_value_amount` END) AS active_deal_value,
 ROUND(100*SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`)/SUM(SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`)) OVER (),1) AS pct_of_value
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_partner`.`acquisition_deal` d
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_partner`.`partner` p ON d.`partner_id`=p.`partner_id`
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY total_deal_value DESC

SELECT p.`partner_type`, COUNT(DISTINCT d.`acquisition_deal_id`) AS active_exclusive_deals, COUNT(DISTINCT d.`partner_id`) AS partners
FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal d
JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner p ON d.`partner_id` = p.`partner_id`
WHERE d.`exclusivity_flag` = true AND d.`deal_status` = 'Active'
GROUP BY ROLLUP(p.`partner_type`) ORDER BY p.`partner_type` IS NULL, active_exclusive_deals DESC

SELECT d.`deal_status`, d.`exclusivity_flag`, COUNT(*) n, MIN(d.`deal_expiration_date`) min_exp, SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_expiration_date` < DATE'2026-11-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) past_exp, SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_effective_date` > DATE'2026-11-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) future_start
FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal d GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT p.`partner_type`, COUNT(DISTINCT d.`acquisition_deal_id`) AS active_exclusive_deals, COUNT(DISTINCT d.`partner_id`) AS partners FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal d JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner p ON d.`partner_id` = p.`partner_id` WHERE d.`exclusivity_flag` = true AND d.`deal_status` = 'Active' GROUP BY ROLLUP(p.`partner_type`) ORDER BY p.`partner_type` IS NULL, active_exclusive_deals DESC

SELECT d.`deal_status`, d.`exclusivity_flag`, COUNT(*) n, MIN(d.`deal_expiration_date`) min_exp, SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_expiration_date` < DATE'2026-11-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) past_exp, SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_effective_date` > DATE'2026-11-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) future_start FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal d GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH ce AS ( SELECT c.churn_event_id, c.subscriber_id, c.last_viewed_title_id, CAST(c.churn_timestamp AS DATE) AS churn_date, s.territory_id FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.churn_event c JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber s ON s.subscriber_id = c.subscriber_id ), flags AS ( SELECT ce.*, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window w WHERE w.title_id = ce.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = ce.territory_id AND w.active_flag = true) AS live_now, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window w WHERE w.title_id = ce.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = ce.territory_id AND w.window_open_date <= ce.churn_date AND (w.window_close_date IS NULL OR w.window_close_date >= ce.churn_date)) AS live_at_churn, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window w WHERE w.title_id = ce.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = ce.territory_id) AS any_window FROM ce ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS churn_events, COUNT(DISTINCT subscriber_id) AS cancelled_subscribers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NULL THEN subscriber_id END) AS no_last_title_recorded, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT live_at_churn THEN subscriber_id END) AS no_live_window_on_cancel_date, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT live_at_churn THEN subscriber_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT subscriber_id), 1) AS pct_no_live_at_cancel, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT live_now THEN subscriber_id END) AS no_live_window_now, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT live_now THEN subscriber_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT subscriber_id), 1) AS pct_no_live_now, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT any_window THEN subscriber_id END) AS never_had_window FROM flags

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT s.`subscriber_id`, p.`plan_type`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` s
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` p
    ON s.`subscription_plan_id` = p.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE s.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
)
SELECT COALESCE(c.`plan_type`, 'No active plan (cancelled)') AS current_plan_type,
       COUNT(*) AS impressions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.`subscriber_id`) AS viewers
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i
LEFT JOIN cur c ON i.`subscriber_id` = c.`subscriber_id`
WHERE i.`delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND i.`delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY impressions DESC

WITH cur AS ( SELECT s.`subscriber_id`, p.`plan_type` FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` s JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` p ON s.`subscription_plan_id` = p.`subscription_plan_id` WHERE s.`subscription_status` = 'Active' ) SELECT COALESCE(c.`plan_type`, 'No active plan (cancelled)') AS current_plan_type, COUNT(*) AS impressions, COUNT(DISTINCT i.`subscriber_id`) AS viewers FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i LEFT JOIN cur c ON i.`subscriber_id` = c.`subscriber_id` WHERE i.`delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND i.`delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY impressions DESC

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT s.`subscriber_id`, p.`plan_type`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` s
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` p
    ON s.`subscription_plan_id` = p.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE s.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
)
SELECT COALESCE(c.`plan_type`, 'No active plan (cancelled)') AS current_plan_type,
       COUNT(*) AS impressions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.`subscriber_id`) AS viewers
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i
LEFT JOIN cur c ON i.`subscriber_id` = c.`subscriber_id`
WHERE i.`delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND i.`delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY impressions DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(t.`content_type`, 'Unmatched') AS content_type, i.`cpm_realized`, i.`currency_code`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i
  LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` e ON i.`content_episode_id` = e.`content_episode_id`
  LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` t ON e.`title_id` = t.`title_id`
)
SELECT content_type,
  COUNT(*) AS impressions,
  ROUND(SUM(cpm_realized)/1000, 2) AS ad_revenue_usd,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(cpm_realized) / SUM(SUM(cpm_realized)) OVER (), 1) AS revenue_share_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(cpm_realized), 2) AS avg_cpm_usd,
  CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(currency_code)) AS currencies
FROM base GROUP BY content_type ORDER BY ad_revenue_usd DESC

WITH base AS ( SELECT COALESCE(t.`content_type`, 'Unmatched') AS content_type, i.`cpm_realized`, i.`currency_code` FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` e ON i.`content_episode_id` = e.`content_episode_id` LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` t ON e.`title_id` = t.`title_id` ) SELECT content_type, COUNT(*) AS impressions, ROUND(SUM(cpm_realized)/1000, 2) AS ad_revenue_usd, ROUND(100 * SUM(cpm_realized) / SUM(SUM(cpm_realized)) OVER (), 1) AS revenue_share_pct, ROUND(AVG(cpm_realized), 2) AS avg_cpm_usd, CONCAT_WS(',', COLLECT_SET(currency_code)) AS currencies FROM base GROUP BY content_type ORDER BY ad_revenue_usd DESC

SELECT COALESCE(t.`territory_group`, 'Unmatched') AS region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.`subscriber_id`) AS ad_viewers,
  COUNT(*) AS impressions
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` s ON i.`subscriber_id` = s.`subscriber_id`
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` t ON s.`territory_id` = t.`territory_id`
WHERE i.`delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND i.`delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'
GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Total (all regions)', COUNT(DISTINCT `subscriber_id`), COUNT(*)
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery`
WHERE `delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND `delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'
ORDER BY ad_viewers DESC

SELECT COALESCE(t.`territory_group`, 'Unmatched') AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT i.`subscriber_id`) AS ad_viewers, COUNT(*) AS impressions FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` s ON i.`subscriber_id` = s.`subscriber_id` LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` t ON s.`territory_id` = t.`territory_id` WHERE i.`delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND i.`delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01' GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'Total (all regions)', COUNT(DISTINCT `subscriber_id`), COUNT(*) FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` WHERE `delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND `delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01' ORDER BY ad_viewers DESC

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `invoice_date`) AS `month`,
    SUM(`subtotal_amount` - `discount_amount`) AS `revenue_without_tax`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice`
  WHERE `invoice_date` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `invoice_date`)
), ranked_months AS (
  SELECT
    `month`,
    `revenue_without_tax`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `revenue_without_tax` DESC, `month` ASC) AS `revenue_rank`
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
  `month`,
  `revenue_without_tax`
FROM ranked_months
WHERE `revenue_rank` <= 1
ORDER BY `revenue_without_tax` DESC, `month` ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS `active_accounts`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber`
WHERE `account_status` = 'Active'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(`invoice`.`subtotal_amount` - `invoice`.`discount_amount`), 2) AS `revenue_without_tax`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice` AS `invoice`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
  ON `invoice`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
  ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`

WITH `monthly_trends` AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp`) AS `month_start`,
    try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `total_watch_time_hours`,
    COUNT(`playback_session`.`playback_session_id`) AS `playback_sessions`,
    AVG(`playback_session`.`completion_percentage`) AS `average_completion_rate`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  WHERE `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` >= ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2026-11-09', -6)
    AND `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` < DATE_ADD(DATE '2026-11-09', 1)
    AND DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp`) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp`)
),
`overall_metrics` AS (
  SELECT
    try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `total_watch_time_hours`,
    COUNT(`playback_session`.`playback_session_id`) AS `playback_sessions`,
    AVG(`playback_session`.`completion_percentage`) AS `average_completion_rate`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  WHERE `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` >= ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2026-11-09', -6)
    AND `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` < DATE_ADD(DATE '2026-11-09', 1)
)
SELECT
  'overall' AS `row_type`,
  CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS `month_start`,
  `overall_metrics`.`total_watch_time_hours`,
  `overall_metrics`.`playback_sessions`,
  `overall_metrics`.`average_completion_rate`
FROM `overall_metrics`
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'monthly_trend' AS `row_type`,
  `monthly_trends`.`month_start`,
  `monthly_trends`.`total_watch_time_hours`,
  `monthly_trends`.`playback_sessions`,
  `monthly_trends`.`average_completion_rate`
FROM `monthly_trends`
ORDER BY `row_type`, `month_start`

WITH `paid_switches` AS (
  SELECT
    `old_sub`.`subscription_id` AS `old_subscription_id`,
    `old_sub`.`subscriber_id`,
    `old_plan`.`plan_name` AS `from_plan`,
    `new_plan`.`plan_name` AS `to_plan`,
    `old_plan`.`base_price` AS `from_base_price`,
    `new_plan`.`base_price` AS `to_base_price`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY `old_sub`.`subscription_id`
      ORDER BY `new_sub`.`activation_date`, `new_sub`.`subscription_id`
    ) AS `rn`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `old_sub`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `old_plan`
    ON `old_sub`.`subscription_plan_id` = `old_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `new_sub`
    ON `old_sub`.`subscriber_id` = `new_sub`.`subscriber_id`
   AND `new_sub`.`activation_date` = `old_sub`.`termination_date`
   AND `new_sub`.`subscription_id` <> `old_sub`.`subscription_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `new_plan`
    ON `new_sub`.`subscription_plan_id` = `new_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE `old_sub`.`subscription_status` = 'Superseded'
    AND `old_sub`.`termination_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `old_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `new_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS `paid_to_paid_switches`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `to_base_price` < `from_base_price` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `downgrade_switches`,
  try_divide(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN `to_base_price` < `from_base_price` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),COUNT(*)) AS `downgrade_share_percent`
FROM `paid_switches`
WHERE `rn` = 1;

WITH reason_counts AS (
  SELECT
    `t`.`territory_group` AS `region`,
    `c`.`cancellation_reason_description` AS `cancellation_reason`,
    COUNT(*) AS `cancellations`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `c`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `s`
    ON `c`.`subscription_id` = `s`.`subscription_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `p`
    ON `s`.`subscription_plan_id` = `p`.`subscription_plan_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `sub`
    ON `c`.`subscriber_id` = `sub`.`subscriber_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `t`
    ON `sub`.`territory_id` = `t`.`territory_id`
  WHERE `c`.`churn_timestamp` >= add_months(DATE'2026-11-10', -12)
    AND `c`.`churn_timestamp` < DATE'2026-11-10'
    AND `p`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `t`.`territory_group` IS NOT NULL
    AND `c`.`cancellation_reason_description` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `t`.`territory_group`, `c`.`cancellation_reason_description`
), ranked_reasons AS (
  SELECT
    `region`,
    `cancellation_reason`,
    `cancellations`,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY `region` ORDER BY `cancellations` DESC) AS `reason_rank`
  FROM reason_counts
)
SELECT
  `region`,
  `cancellation_reason`,
  `cancellations`
FROM ranked_reasons
WHERE `reason_rank` = 1
ORDER BY `region`, `cancellation_reason`

WITH `monthly_refunds` AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `processing_date`) AS `month`,
    SUM(`amount`) AS `processed_refund_amount`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`refund`
  WHERE `refund_status` = 'Processed'
    AND `processing_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `processing_date` >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE'2026-11-10')
    AND `processing_date` < ADD_MONTHS(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE'2026-11-10'), 12)
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `processing_date`)
), `running_refunds` AS (
  SELECT
    `month`,
    `processed_refund_amount`,
    SUM(`processed_refund_amount`) OVER (ORDER BY `month` ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `running_total_amount`
  FROM `monthly_refunds`
)
SELECT `month`, `processed_refund_amount`, `running_total_amount`
FROM `running_refunds`
WHERE `running_total_amount` > 100000
ORDER BY `month`
LIMIT 1
